scripts.quality: bun run lint && bun run check
scripts.lint: bun x --bun eslint src tests scripts
scripts.lint:fix: bun x --bun eslint src tests scripts --fix
scripts.test: bun run precompile && bun test tests --path-ignore-patterns '**/*.integration.test.ts' --preload ../../tooling/test-support/unit-preload.ts
